root_cause: The benchmark loaded the anon key from .env.local, so bible_translations was invisible under current RLS. sw-biblica exists when queried with an evaluation-only service-role key.
required_configuration_changes: Load SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY from evaluation/speech_lab/.env.evaluation before evaluation-only Supabase access is initialized.
Ensure benchmark runs do not stop at an env file containing only VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.
Do not put service-role credentials in frontend/Vite env files.
Keep text_provider_options.translation set to sw-biblica for this database.
